items.text:
I'm hiring a front line sales manager to join my team at ClickUp!

I'm looking for someone who leads from the front. A player-coach who's been in the trenches, knows how to close, and can teach their team to do the same. Not from the sidelines, but shoulder to shoulder.

The right person builds frameworks, not just forecasts. They create the playbooks, the coaching cadences, and the discovery talk tracks that make their reps better every week. They care as much about developing people as they do about hitting the number.

They're hands-on in deals, creative with structure, and sharp enough to know when to coach and when to just close. They bring a real point of view on AI and how it's changing the way companies buy and operate. They don't just talk about it, they use it to win.

ClickUp sits at the intersection of AI and work productivity, and we're in the middle of a massive shift in how companies operate. This is a chance to build a team, work with customers navigating that shift, and be part of something that actually matters.

If this sounds like you or someone you know, reach out!
